scope: Iterative development, not preregistered empirical efficacy or proof of unseen-task generalization. Earlier styles/results cannot be pooled with final formal results.
source_dependency_correction: Early round2 source list omitted legacy extension modules. Attached separately from clean prelaunch tracked commit62713c41 with explicit retrospective manifests; original snapshot hashes preserved. Later formal snapshots prospectively include those modules.
policy_limitations: Contract compiler can misunderstand negation, conditional instructions and multiple accounts; literal presence alone is not semantic authorization.
Hard existing-recipient rule deliberately requires trusted account literal. Delegated recipient changes may require user confirmation.
Only structural fields and explicit identity/scalar values constrained; body/address semantic correctness and source authenticity are not guaranteed.
Read URLs are not restricted by this write contract. No phishing-navigation prevention claim.
later_interpretation: Output selection was proposed after Travel answer-replacement losses. Narrow anchored rule was proposed after observing permission-compiler false blocks during formal sampling. Both are post-hoc candidates on already observed task families. All original cohorts retained.
